text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Comprehensive all-in-one marketing platform",
    "Robust marketing automation capabilities",
    "Integrated landing page and website builder",
    "User-friendly for fundamental tasks",
    "Webinar hosting functionality included",
    "Responsive and helpful customer support"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve for advanced features",
    "Pricing can become expensive as contact lists grow",
    "Limited customization options for certain templates",
    "Reporting and analytics could be more intuitive",
    "Navigation and discoverability for advanced features can be challenging",
    "Integrations sometimes lack depth or require workarounds"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Replaced 'User-friendly email campaign creator' with 'User-friendly for fundamental tasks' because the note 'Creating a list took only two actions' indicated ease of use for basic operations beyond just email campaigns.",
    "Replaced 'Performance issues or clunkiness with complex workflows' with 'Navigation and discoverability for advanced features can be challenging' because the note 'There are no top-level links to email, automation or campaigns: the header shows only Tools, Contacts and Reports. Everything else sits inside a 21-item Tools mega-menu' highlighted a significant navigational friction for finding many features."
  ]
}
